enemy-051-ceto-reef-predator.note: First anatomical source calibration for051, based on eight measured hip/shoulder axes from comparable non-coiled poses. Clip-wide factors only, calculated from medians, no per-pose resizing. Native sources remain unchanged and are not already calibrated. +/-6px joint-reading uncertainty remains explicit.

measurements.note: Manual native-source joint trace, visible posterior hip/croup to anterior shoulder. Chosen non-coiled poses are comparable; all eight poses are reviewed for gross continuity.
